FLUQON.QPON / ABOUT

Fluke on Coupon.

Australian offers. Clear conditions. A useful place to start.

What we’re building

fluqon.qpon is an Australian coupon and offer site. The aim is simple: help you find the code, understand the conditions and check the final price without wading through marketing noise.

The live feed shows published offers with a current dated check. Until offers have been checked and published, that feed stays empty. preview.fluq_ opens a separate set of unchecked examples.

What you can do here

Search and filter the feed, save offers on this device, copy a code and share a branded link. Report a failed code directly to the private review queue. You can install the site as an app. No account is required for these features.

This service does not currently pay cashback, hold a shopping balance or process purchases. You buy directly from the retailer under its terms.

How offers earn a place

  1. Find the offer at its original source.
  2. Record the price, eligibility, exclusions, delivery costs and expiry where available.
  3. Check the code or checkout conditions and record when it was checked.
  4. Show what was verified and flag uncertainty.
  5. Recheck reports and remove or mark patched offers.

Publishing requires a source, conditions, an expiry and a successful dated check for the current offer revision. A merchant check confirms the retailer’s published offer. A checkout check records an accepted code or price. Checks expire after 24 hours, or four hours for glitches. Edits require a new check. A past check cannot guarantee your checkout: stock, eligibility and retailer decisions can change.

How money fits in

The sample links currently have no affiliate tracking codes. If we introduce commission links or paid placements, we will label them clearly beside the relevant offer.

Get in touch

Send a question, correction or offer suggestion to sayvon@fluqon.qpon. Include the retailer, offer link and what needs checking. Please leave payment details and passwords out of your message.
